adaptations.paper_value: Information discreteness (ID): the sign of the formation-period cumulative return (PRET) times the percentage of formation-period days with negative daily returns minus the percentage with positive daily returns. Daily return signs are equally weighted, ignoring magnitude. Small (low) ID = continuous information; large (high) ID = discrete information. Stocks are first sorted on PRET, then on ID.
